modalLead: Health and Inbox pick up where v2026.08.08.3 left off — shareable row links, a healthy-percent badge in the view, filter trails under the section title like Config, a header badge that keeps refreshing while you stay on bookmarks, and a pile of reliability fixes from the health audit.

items.text: Shareable row links with hv_id — open, select, and share one health row with a URL like /?hv_id=1:4#health, the same idea as Inbox ib_id. Filter, sort, and search still sync to hv_filter, hv_sort, and hv_q; Share in the row menu copies a dashboard deep link instead of the raw bookmark URL (dashboard-health.js).

Healthy % in the panel head — the header badge shows how many bookmarks have no active issue (e.g. 25%), with a tooltip for the exact count. The old average-score-only reading is gone (dashboard-health.js, locales).

Filter trail under the title — health › monitored sits below Health and above the subtitle, matching Config subpages. The large dashboard title stays the view name only (dashboard-health.js, dashboard-page-nav.js).

More filters and tiles — stale, unused, missing preview, shortcut conflicts, and healthy appear when they have rows; KPI tiles add stale and unused; Periodic these N sits beside bulk Monitor; pills and tiles scroll on one row (dashboard-health.js, health-view.css).
R / ? reload the cached report — keyboard refresh fetches a fresh server report without a retest-all run; Home/End jump to first and last row (dashboard-health.js).
Parallel report fetches dedupe — overlapping /api/bookmark-health calls share one in-flight request; a refresh request never joins a plain fetch that would return stale rows (dashboard-health.js).
Escape while the view is still loading — closing Health during lazy load no longer leaves a stuck loading shell (dashboard-health-loader.js).
Filter trail under the title — inbox › unread (or a domain filter) sits below Inbox, same placement as Health and Config (dashboard-inbox.js, dashboard-page-nav.js).
Parallel inbox fetches dedupe — concurrent /api/inbox calls share one in-flight fetchItems promise (dashboard-inbox.js).
Right-click Share on inbox rows — inbox items expose the same copy/share entries as bookmark rows once the context menu module is loaded (dashboard-inbox.js, dashboard-context-menu.js).

Header health badge polls outside the view — the heartbeat icon refreshes about once a minute on bookmarks and Inbox while Health keeps its own live refresh on the Monitored filter (dashboard-visual.js, dashboard-setup.js).

Share works before the context menu module loads — health and inbox rows reach clipboard/share through a loader stub on the first click, not after a silent no-op (dashboard-bookmark-interactions-loader.js).
Health report builds singleflight — concurrent /api/bookmark-health requests wait on one in-flight build instead of each recomputing the full report (handlers.go).
HTTP 4xx counts as reachable — GitHub and similar hosts that answer probes with 404 are no longer marked down; only 5xx is treated as unreachable (ping.go).
